summary: std/asn1: `parse` reads nested values by offset instead of slicing each level, which copied the input per level there (800 KB of nesting ran wasm out of memory)
details: `parse` reads nested values by offset instead of slicing each level, which copied the input per level there (800 KB of nesting ran wasm out of memory). Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/asn1; WebAssembly and Go backends): `parse` reads nested values by offset instead of slicing each level, which copied the input per level there (800 KB of nesting ran wasm out of memory). Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
